title: Liver & Onions
summary: One hand-sized slice at a time, in about nine minutes.
intro: The same technique works for other livers too: pork, chicken, goose.

steps: **Assemble** the ingredients and slice the onion.

pace.text: If stopping, just store the onion in an airtight bag.

steps: **Heat** the butter and/or EVOO, stir in the garlic and salt, and add the onion on top.

ingredients.item: slice of beef or calf liver

steps: **Place** the slice of liver on top of the onion. Cook no more than 90 seconds.

pace.text: Timed from here to the end.

steps: **Flip** the liver over and cook no more than 90 seconds.
**Flip** it back to the original side. Once the red fluid mostly stops, it’s DONE and must come off immediately.
**Slide** the liver onto a plate and pour the sauté over it. Enjoy with bread, toast, crackers, or as-is.
**Sauté** {qty:1/2 cup} sliced onion and {qty:1 tbsp} minced garlic in butter or EVOO until almost done.
**Place** the liver on top of the onion. No more than 90 seconds.
**Flip** the liver, still on top. No more than 90 seconds.
**Flip** again. When the red fluid almost stops appearing on top (30 seconds at most), it’s done.
**Serve** immediately. Or purée it into a beef gravy.
keys: Works for pork, chicken and goose liver too
